## Brand Guidelines

### 2018

#### Brand Summary

##### Mission

- Powerful in purpose. Efficient in design. Ryzen aims to empower digital creators, VR pioneers, game world explorers, and tech thrill-seekers to imagine, code, and conquer without boundaries in the immersive computing era [^1].

##### Core Values

- empowerment
- strength
- efficiency
- uniqueness
- determination
- innovation

##### Target Audience

- Digital creators, VR pioneers, game world explorers, tech thrill-seekers, and those determined to push boundaries in immersive computing [^2].

##### Personality Traits

- kindred spirit
- determined
- empowering
- bold
- imaginative
- unique

##### Visual Identity Overview

- The visual identity centers on bold, modern logos with a circular brushstroke motif symbolizing Zen philosophy, using a gradient from deep red to bright orange. The design is sleek, minimalistic, and emphasizes clarity, consistency, and technological innovation across all media [^3].

#### Categories

##### Brand Voice

- Powerful in purpose. Efficient in design.
- A kindred spirit, determined to empower you on the journey.
- With Ryzen, we offer a new form of strength. Powerful and determined in purpose, unique and efficient in design. Ready to empower the spirit of the bold and ignite the imagination of exceptional minds. Ryzen will enable the digital creators, VR pioneers, game world explorers, and tech thrill-seekers. Those determined to imagine, code, and conquer without boundaries in the immersive computing era.

##### Brand Imagery

- Use of any stylized, animated, hand drawn or alternate versions of an unofficial logo is not permitted. This undermines the logo system and brand consistency.
- There is an alternate version of the Ryzen Threadripper logo available for use. This version of the Ryzen Threadripper logo should be used when legibility of the brand would be compromised when the logo is reduced for consistency.

##### Color Palette

- The Ryzen logos are available in RGB for web and CMYK for print. If spot color is required please contact Brand.Team@amd.com
- YELLOW: CMYK : C0 M48 Y100 K0 Pantone : Promatch PMS 144 RGB : R157 G000 B020 HEX : #970a1b
- RED: CMYK : C0 M100 Y96 K28 Pantone : Promatch PMS 1807 RGB : R157 G000 B020 HEX : #970a1b
- Please use the same color guidance for the Ryzen Threadripper and Ryzen Pro logos

##### Typography

- Use of any stylized, animated, hand drawn or alternate versions of an unofficial logo is not permitted. This undermines the logo system and brand consistency.

##### Logo Usage

- Use of any stylized, animated, hand drawn or alternate versions of an unofficial logo is not permitted. This undermines the logo system and brand consistency.
- There is an alternate version of the Ryzen Threadripper logo available for use. This version of the Ryzen Threadripper logo should be used when legibility of the brand would be compromised when the logo is reduced for consistency.

##### Tone And Messaging

- Brand promise Powerful in purpose. Efficient in design.
- Brand personality A kindred spirit, determined to empower you on the journey.
- Brand story With Ryzen, we offer a new form of strength. Powerful and determined in purpose, unique and efficient in design. Ready to empower the spirit of the bold and ignite the imagination of exceptional minds. Ryzen will enable the digital creators, VR pioneers, game world explorers, and tech thrill-seekers. Those determined to imagine, code, and conquer without boundaries in the immersive computing era.

##### Brand Values

- Powerful in purpose. Efficient in design.
- A kindred spirit, determined to empower you on the journey.
- With Ryzen, we offer a new form of strength. Powerful and determined in purpose, unique and efficient in design. Ready to empower the spirit of the bold and ignite the imagination of exceptional minds. Ryzen will enable the digital creators, VR pioneers, game world explorers, and tech thrill-seekers. Those determined to imagine, code, and conquer without boundaries in the immersive computing era.

##### Visual Style

- Use of any stylized, animated, hand drawn or alternate versions of an unofficial logo is not permitted. This undermines the logo system and brand consistency.
- There is an alternate version of the Ryzen Threadripper logo available for use. This version of the Ryzen Threadripper logo should be used when legibility of the brand would be compromised when the logo is reduced for consistency.

##### Layout And Composition

- Use of any stylized, animated, hand drawn or alternate versions of an unofficial logo is not permitted. This undermines the logo system and brand consistency.
- There is an alternate version of the Ryzen Threadripper logo available for use. This version of the Ryzen Threadripper logo should be used when legibility of the brand would be compromised when the logo is reduced for consistency.

##### Brand Architecture

- Use of any stylized, animated, hand drawn or alternate versions of an unofficial logo is not permitted. This undermines the logo system and brand consistency.
- NOTE: There is an alternate version of the Ryzen Threadripper logo available for use. This version of the Ryzen Threadripper logo should be used when legibility of the brand would be compromised when the logo is reduced for consistency.

##### Co Branding

- AMD wordmarks and partner logos should be the same relative size.
- All partner logos must be in either 100% black or reversed to white.
- If logos appear side-by-side, please separate with a vertical rule. See examples below.
- Please note: The following legal line must be used in all advertising, and promotional materials which incorporate AMD and /or the AMD Arrow logo and/or, Ryzen and/or the Ryzen logo, Radeon and/or the Radeon logo. AMD, the AMD Arrow logo, Ryzen, Radeon, [add used and/or remove unused AMD trademarks as necessary] and combinations thereof are trademarks of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
- Please note: The following legal line must be used in all advertising, and promotional materials which incorporate AMD and /or the AMD Arrow logo and/or, Ryzen and/or the Ryzen logo, and/or Ryzen Threadripper and/or Ryzen Threadripper logo, Radeon and/or the Radeon logo. AMD, the AMD Arrow logo, Ryzen, Threadripper, Radeon, [add used and/or remove unused AMD trademarks as necessary] and combinations thereof are trademarks of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
- AMD should be the lead brand on all collateral.
- Partner logos must appear as either 100% black or reversed to white.
- AMD Ryzen/Radeon lockup should appear above the partner logo if the layout allows it.
- AMD Ryzen/Radeon lockup should be twice the size of the partner logo.
- When logos are side by side, include a dividing rule line between AMD Ryzen/Radeon lockup and its external partner.
- In cases where the perceptions or equity of partner brands are unclear, create a distance of at least twice the logo length between the AMD Ryzen/Radeon lockup and partner logos.
- If the contract or partner guidelines do not specify a visual treatment, the following guidance applies. For the instance where a partner brand enjoys greater relevance among end users and customers, allow the partner logo to lead on the left (or above if there are space constraints).
- AMD Ryzen/Radeon lockup and partner logos should be the same relative size and separated by a vertical line.
- Surrounding elements are in the partner’s look and feel; if partner guidelines allow, consider using the AMD look and feel.
